items.briefing:
A sophisticated phishing tool called Logokit is creating convincing fake login pages in real time, automatically pulling in company logos and branding to trick users into entering their credentials. This makes phishing emails harder to spot, as the fake pages look almost identical to legitimate ones. Separately, a security incident involving AI platform Hugging Face has raised concerns about risks from AI tools used in workplaces, with questions emerging around liability and data exposure.

**Practical tip:** Before entering your username or password anywhere, double-check the web address in your browser bar — a convincing logo doesn't mean the site is genuine.
